summary.key_theme: 儘管近期受大盤回調影響出現股價波動，但華爾街分析師持續看好其 AI 安全領域的競爭優勢與強勁的平台成長動能。

bullish.title: Wells Fargo Maintains Overweight on Palo Alto Networks, Raises Price Target to $525
bullish.reason: Wells Fargo 分析師 Michael Turrin 維持「加碼」評級並調升目標價至 525 美元，反映出對公司在網路安全支出動能改善下的強勁信心。

bullish.title: PANW vs. CRWD: Which Cybersecurity Stock Has an Edge Right Now?
bullish.reason: 分析指出 Palo Alto Networks 憑藉強大的平台成長與 SASE 預訂量增長，在與 CrowdStrike 的競爭中展現出明顯的市場優勢。

bullish.title: Palo Alto Networks (PANW) Expands Into Critical Infrastructure Cybersecurity
bullish.reason: 公司成為 Anthropic 關鍵基礎設施防禦計畫的創始合作夥伴，進一步鞏固其在 AI 安全與關鍵基礎設施保護領域的領導地位。

bullish.title: Wall Street Left Software for Dead: 4 Stocks Institutions Are Buying Back
bullish.reason: 機構投資人重新買入軟體股，Palo Alto Networks 被列為重點回補標的，顯示市場資金對其長期價值的認可。

bearish.title: Palo Alto Networks (PANW) Declines More Than Market: Some Information for Investors
bearish.reason: 股價單日下跌 5.54%，跌幅超過大盤，反映出在近期高點後市場出現獲利了結壓力。

bearish.title: PubMatic, Bandwidth, Palo Alto Networks, Unity, and Five9 Shares Are Falling, What You Need To Know
bearish.reason: 受美國勞工統計局數據影響，大盤整體回調導致軟體類股普遍下跌，屬於系統性風險而非公司基本面惡化。

neutral.title: Is Palo Alto Networks (PANW) Priced For Its Future Cash Flow?
neutral.reason: 探討公司估值與未來現金流的匹配度，文章中立地分析了 AI 安全帶來的成長潛力與高估值之間的平衡。

neutral.title: Palo Alto (PANW) Is Considered a Good Investment by Brokers: Is That True?
